analysis: Complete Trace B input structure; no measured cache hits or latency

methods.history: cohort-local inputs at strictly earlier arrivals; simultaneous inputs excluded
methods.historical_retention: unlimited observed input history; no residency or completion assumptions
methods.session_unit: connected observed parent component; singleton roots need not be independent user sessions
methods.depth: observed parent-path node count, reported separately from source turn
methods.observation_interval: [0, floor(max_timestamp)+1); partial end bins excluded from dispersion
methods.population: entire pinned Trace B; no sampling; cohorts kept separate
methods.cohort_selection: all records, plus observed-root components uniform in each discovered exact type label
methods.failures: zero outputs audited; no error/status field, so successful completion cannot be established
methods.cooccurrence: legacy descriptive grid retained for comparability; improved disjoint comparisons are separate temporal results

lineage.depth_definition: 1 for a node whose parent is absent or -1; one plus observed parent's depth otherwise
